Summary: Role of Nurse Practitioners
The primary focus of nutrition therapy for renal disease includes management of 
appropriate protein and calorie intake, fluid and electrolyte balance, as well as the 
need for specific vitamins and minerals, especially vitamin D and iron. Since recom-
mendations for each of these elements varies according to the type and stage of renal 
disease, Nurse Practitioners should have a general knowledge of the guidelines within 
each disease state. Nurse Practitioners can manage renal patients and support the 
nutritional recommendation and treatment plan developed by the dietitian. Nurse
